entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Sales', 'Support', or 'Returns' to be connected.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. I see you're looking for help with a return. How can I assist you today?
Yeah, you can assist me by taking back these useless cycling shoes you sold me. I've had them for a month and they're absolute garbage. I want my money back, now.

I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

A fault? Your company is at fault! These things gave me horrible blisters on my last ride. And the cleats never feel secure, no matter how much I adjust them. I'm not looking for a lecture, I want a refund. This is unacceptable.

I understand your frustration, and getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just pull up your order information to check the return eligibility. Can I get your order number or the email address you used for the purchase?

It's angrycustomer@email.com. And you better not give me the runaround. If you can't process this, put me on with a manager. I'm one click away from leaving a review that will make sure no one ever buys your cycling shoes again.
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see your order for the Mountain Bike Shoes, delivered 33 days ago. Let me just review the policy here.
What is there to review? Just do it! Are you stalling?

Not at all. And good news, I can definitely help with that. According to our policy, your item is well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh. Well... it's about time. So what happens now?

I've just sent a pre-paid return label to your email on file. Just print it out, package the shoes in their original box if possible, and drop it off at any post office. Once our warehouse receives the item, your full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
Fine. I'll get it sent back this week. I expect to see that money.
You certainly will. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
